update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.3 - Scoring: OCR ceiling and soft-cap completion-percent refinements
Optimized --------- - OCR stat ceiling raised from 1800 to 1950, covering Trackblazer Stamina reads up to the hard cap of 1900 (base 1200 + scenario bonus 700). The previous ceiling caused the bot to reject legitimate high-Stamina stat reads in Trackblazer runs. - completionPercent in the training scorer now uses the same 0.5x discount above 1200 as effectiveGain, so a stat of 1300 targeting 1400 is correctly treated as ~96% done rather than 93%. Previously the raw ratio overstated how far away the target was, biasing the scorer toward over-investing in already-soft-capped stats. - 4 new unit tests covering the July 2026 soft-cap logic: below-cap linearity, spanning-boundary partial discount, above-cap halving, and effective-completionPercent bucket placement with above-1200 targets.
